_doc: Repos that are DELIBERATELY local-only. remote-coverage-check.py fails on any remote-less repo NOT listed here. An entry is a recorded decision, not a mute button: it needs a reason someone can argue with, and 'unblock' means either pushing the repo or changing the reason. Never delete a repo to clear the gate.
_scar: 2026-07-29 audit: 12 remote-less repos found, oldest 219 commits. Two of them must never get a GitHub remote (a minor's medical/education record). An always-on auto-push would have published them, which is why creation is opt-in and this file exists.

Re-identifying against the founder's public identity. Not pushable even privately until that content moves to a gitignored path.
